simple.meaning: דְּלִי (dᵉlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a pail or jar (for drawing water).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דְּלִי (H1805) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 24:7, with occurrences in Numbers, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דְּלִי (H1805) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דְּלִי (H1805) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דְּלִי (dᵉlîy) / H1805 is traced through Numbers 24:7, Isaiah 40:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
